Proposition (A scoped intrinsic adaptation). Let EextE_{\rm ext} be an ordinary compact-test space with chart/support final topology of the intrinsic type described in Section 1. Assume:

  2. On every fixed external chart/support stage, the compact support has a finite cover by ordinary interiors of compact affinoid refinements, with fixed unit moments and finite polyhedral images. Restriction to those images is continuous for the intrinsic seminorms. Fixed affine coordinate changes, including reflection between log⁡\log and −log⁡-\log, induce the indicated pullbacks. Conversely a native cutoff presentation, after adjoining fixed cutoff moments, is represented by one fixed external stage.

  3. On each finite refinement needed in (ii), the coefficient quotient map onto the relevant intrinsic compatible-tuple space is strict (a quotient map). This follows, for example, from (eq:reverse), or from the supported extension in Proposition prop:extension when that is the exact sector in use.

Then the identification is a homeomorphism for τa\tau_a and the external final topology. Under these hypotheses the strong-dual conclusions of Theorem thm:log transfer, with the same underlying bounded sets. Without (iii) only the native-to-external continuity provided by the coefficient restriction argument is obtained from these assumptions.
